display_long_description:
# Match. Explore. Compete. In Mixed Reality.

Jolly Match 3 MR is a free-to-play mixed-reality puzzle game with 1000+ levels, interactive environments, weekly events, team challenges, and plenty of ways to play at your own pace.

Winner of **Best in AR/MR Experiences** at the **QLD XR Festival 2025** and **Best XR/VR** at **gamescom latam BIG Festival 2026**.

Swap tiles, create powerful combos, use unique boosters, build miniature worlds, and compete for your place on the leaderboard.

# Endless Puzzles to Master

Explore varied layouts, goals, combinations, and challenges. Use boosters and chosen helpers when things get tricky.

[media]

# Weekly Events & Leaderboards

Take on weekly events, collect trophies, climb the leaderboard, and aim for a higher spot each week.

[media]

# Team Up & Play Together

Join a team, take part in team events, earn rewards, request and send lives, and work together on challenges.

[media]

# Build Miniature Worlds

Rebuild islands inspired by New York, San Francisco, Texas, Venice, and Paris. Earn stars to unlock objects, decorate each area, and search for hidden objects. Move, zoom, and rotate your worlds in mixed reality.

[media]

# Play in Mixed Reality

Place, move, and resize the gameboard to fit your space. Use hand tracking, controllers, or hand rays to interact.

[media]

# Daily Quests & Rewards

Return each day for quests and rewards. Complete challenges to unlock boosters, and keep your progress moving.

[media]

Share your progress, chat with other players, and get the latest news on JollyCo Discord: **https://discord.gg/jollycovr**
